description: This header file declares a component function for the 'boot state machine' in the cuttlefish project. It includes necessary headers and defines a function returning a dependency injection component tailored for initializing the boot process of Cuttlefish virtual devices.

methods.name: bootStateMachineComponent
methods.description: Declares a dependency injection component for setting up the boot state machine, requiring configuration and runtime objects related to Cuttlefish and VM management.
